description: Narrative threads running through Book 1 of The Blue Hour, tracking the central mystery, character arcs, and series set-up. Each thread aligns with the 10-chapter act structure and the directive for concrete partial answers every 2-3 chapters.

threads.name: The Lake House Secret
threads.book1_resolution: Elena recovers the full memory of Tomas's drowning and her role, accepts the truth, and reintegrates her severed self. The central mystery is fully resolved.
threads.book1_payoff: The reader learns exactly what happened at the lake, why Elena split herself, and experiences the catharsis of her reintegration.
threads.note: Primary investigative thread driving the entire plot.

threads.name: The Girl in Blue
threads.book1_resolution: Through reintegration, the girl in blue merges back into Elena's consciousness, ceasing to appear as a separate reflection. The haunting ends.
threads.book1_payoff: The final revelation that the girl is Elena's own younger self, and the poignant resolution when Elena 'takes her back' at the water's edge.
threads.note: Reflection-only apparition, never speaks. Represents Elena's suppressed childhood self.

threads.name: The Drowning of Tomas
threads.book1_resolution: The hidden diary/lockbox concretely names Tomas and implicates Elena; full memory recovery by chapter 9 confirms her presence at his drowning.
threads.book1_payoff: The core tragedy and guilt are laid bare, enabling the final choice.
threads.note: Buried true event; hints appear earlier but concrete evidence surfaces in Act 2.

threads.name: Elena's Reintegration
threads.book1_resolution: Elena makes the choice at the water's edge to accept the memory and guilt, becoming whole. Her arc from fragmented to integrated completes.
threads.book2_promise: Her new wholeness positions her to face Cora's parallel mystery in Book 2.
threads.book1_payoff: Emotional catharsis of choosing to remember and live with the truth, fulfilling the emotional question.
threads.note: Internal arc thread; milestones: first flashback (ch1), mid-point realization (ch5), final choice (ch10).

threads.name: Diane's Secret
threads.book1_resolution: Diane's unwillingness to explain is broken when the full memory returns; the truth of what Diane knew and why she kept silent is revealed.
threads.book2_promise: Elena and Diane may begin to reconcile, leaving room for further exploration if needed.
threads.book1_payoff: The reader and Elena understand why Diane tried to keep her away — a mixture of guilt and protection.
threads.note: Diane is the living keeper of the secret; her phone calls escalate tension.

threads.name: Cora's Shadow
threads.book1_resolution: Cora's final diary entry reveals she also split herself and left a shade. The discovery is made but not resolved.
threads.book2_promise: This becomes the central mystery of Book 2: finding and dealing with Cora's second shadow.
threads.book1_payoff: Provides a shocking twist that the phenomenon was not unique to Elena, and sets up the sequel.
threads.note: Series-level thread; opened in the final act, intentionally unresolved.
